sloka: एतच्च पुष्पकं नाम विमानं सूर्यसन्निभम् ।प्रतिगृह्णीष्व यानार्थं त्रिदशैः समतां व्रज ।। ७.३.१९ ॥
transliteration: etacca puṣpakaṁ nāma vimānaṁ sūryasannibham ।pratigṛhṇīṣva yānārthaṁ tridaśaiḥ samatāṁ vraja ।। 7.3.19 ॥

translations.english: "And accept this aerial chariot named Pushpaka, which resembles the sun, for your travels, and thereby attain equality with the gods."
